name: Wildflowers
source:
A troubled actress and a frustrated army officer steal a rare endangered flower from the top of Mount Megiddo.

[From [url=https://dancingengie.itch.io/wildflowers]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位陷入困境的女演员和一位失意的军官从米吉多山顶偷走了一朵稀有的濒临灭绝的花朵。

[来自[url=https://dancingengie.itch.io/wildflowers]Itch.io[/url]]
